repo:objectstack#7 · os-alice · session_011y7As5bdhV5T4N9vpjmZzH

Pre-dispatch notes from the ADR-0159 revision (PR #37206, Contract review 7152605084 and delta 7155715384):
1. Item 1 says an unreadable body "keeps closing every link it names". The revised D7-c says that on the pre-upgrade release both doors answer for that row as they do today, because rule 7 runs on `main` and on the major, not there. Align item 1 with that wording before dispatch.
2. Add one fold fixture: a served internal record form (no link) ahead of another stored row of the same name that carries an open link, e.g. a writable package's own row ahead of a package-less row. D7-d already decides this case: the served row is found over the stored set as it stood before the run, and a body not served today is never served. So the fold must be computed before any removal. A per-row classifier would delete the internal row and then move the linked row under D7-a.
